description: Owner correction (2026-11-10): the four 'Eldoran' occurrences in 00_dialogue.jsonl (episode 18 finale, DL518_12.bin, speaker block 240-243) are the same entity the v2.7-PL6 skill port already aligned to 'Eldran' (JP エルドラン; cf. glossary: 'Anime Midstream/ANN use Eldran'). PL dialogues already use 'Eldran'. The owner ruled: 'Eldran powinno być nie Eldoran.' Same fix, EN package side: Eldoran -> Eldran in these 4 dialogue rows; matching reference edit in docs/reading-script/english-reference/srwoe_episode_18.md (4 occurrences) and re-pin of its reference_sha256 in polish/episode_18.json. Source bindings unchanged: the reading-script source audit accepts the renewed file only while it reverses exactly to the audited baseline (tools/polish_reading_script.py: undo_en_eldran_dialogue).

called Eldoran, is it not?
changes.after:
I know of it…
Your own planet is protected by a guardian
called Eldran, is it not?
changes.reason: Terminology alignment with skill port (eldran-2026-10-21-en-port.json) and PL dialogues; owner 2026-11-10.
